lines.en: label dormwartwo16:
scene outsidethechurch1
Hi.
lines.zh: 你好。

lines.en: It’s me again.
lines.zh: 又是我。

lines.en: A short while ago, you saw something you were not supposed to see.
lines.zh: 不久前，你看到了一些你不该看到的东西。

lines.en: Forget about it.
lines.zh: 忘了它吧。

lines.en: Not doing so is dangerous for a number of reasons...but, as I care deeply about you, I will go against the grain and share one of these despite the specific instructions I have been given.
lines.zh: 不这么做会出于种种原因而危险……不过，因为我非常在乎你，我会破例违抗指示，把其中一条告诉你——尽管我被明确吩咐过不能说。

lines.en: Because not doing so would be dangerous for {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: 因为不说出来，对{i}我{/i}而言才是危险的。

lines.en: And I like existing, you know?
lines.zh: 而且我喜欢「存在」这件事，你懂吧？

lines.en: I like where I am in life- looking down from the monorail and watching the asphalt centerlines blend together into one continuous stretch of white from my prefecture to yours.
lines.zh: 我喜欢自己现在所处的位置——从单轨电车往下望，看着柏油路上的中线融合成一条连绵的白线，从我的县一直延伸到你的县。

lines.en: Riddled with cars that look like toys...and the wires above and beside me, shaking in the wind as I journey closer to you.
lines.zh: 沿途点缀着像玩具一样的汽车……还有我上方和身旁的电线，在风中颤动，伴着我离你越来越近。

lines.en: Of course, that future hangs in the balance as is.
lines.zh: 当然，那份未来如今仍悬而未决。

lines.en: Anyway, you’re probably wondering what that thing I just told you I was going to tell you about is. So I’ll tell you because I told you I’d tell you. But don’t tell anyone because there’s no telling what that would do.
lines.zh: 总之，你大概在好奇我刚才说要告诉你的那件事是什么。那我就告诉你，因为我说过会告诉你。但别告诉任何人，因为谁也说不准那会造成什么后果。

lines.en: The past itself isn’t dangerous.
lines.zh: 过去本身并不危险。

lines.en: It’s the way it makes you feel that is.
lines.zh: 危险的是它带给你的感受。

lines.en: Take these words, reel them in through the crack underneath the door of that building I can’t enter, and wrap them around your neck like a scarf, not a noose.
lines.zh: 收下这些话，把它们从我进不去的那栋楼门缝里一点点拉进来，然后像围巾一样绕在脖子上，而不是像绞索。

lines.en: Feel comfort in me, for I have felt comfort in you.
lines.zh: 在我身上感受安慰吧，因为我曾在你身上感受过安慰。

lines.en: Even when you thought I never would.
lines.zh: 即便在你以为我永远不会的时候。

lines.en: : I wonder how much longer they’re going to be in there for.
lines.zh: : 我好奇她们还要在里面待多久。

lines.en: : I figured Rin would have wiped the floor with Yasu by now. No offense, Touka.
lines.zh: : 我还以为 Rin 这会儿早把 Yasu 打得落花流水了。无意冒犯，Touka。

lines.en: : None taken. I also expect Rin to emerge victorious as Yasu sometimes forgets to even eat breakfast and I can’t imagine her information retention is very good.
lines.zh: : 不介意。我也认为 Rin 会获胜，毕竟 Yasu 有时连早饭都会忘记吃，我很难想象她的信息保持能力能有多好。

lines.en: : We’ve got this fancy word for “information retention” called “memory.” Try saying that next time.
lines.zh: : 我们有个更体面的词来指代「信息保持能力」，叫「记忆力」。下次试试这么说。

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch2
: Apologies for speaking in a way more befitting my status, Miss Imai. We can’t all be-
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我说话的方式大概太符合我的身份了，Imai 小姐。我们不可能人人都——

lines.en: : Black? You trying to throw down?
lines.zh: : 黑人？你想干架是吧？

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch3
: What?! Heavens, no. That wasn’t even remotely close to-
lines.zh: : 什么？！天哪，当然不是。那根本就扯不上——

lines.en: : Relax, Mrs. Bezos. I’m just screwing with you and trying to lighten the mood since there’s no telling how long us three are gonna be stuck out here for.
lines.zh: : 放松点，Bezos 夫人。我只是逗你玩、想让气氛轻松点，毕竟谁也说不准我们三个要在这儿困多久。

lines.en: : Why don’t we just go inside then? I doubt they locked the doors on us.
lines.zh: : 那我们为什么不直接进去？我不信他们会把门反锁上。

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch4
: Yasu has mentioned to me on many occasions that the doors are locked for anyone that her god does not acknowledge.
lines.zh: : Yasu 跟我提过很多次，凡是不被她的神认可的人，那些门都是锁着的。

lines.en: : Does her god not acknowledge {i}you?{/i} Aren’t you guys best friends?
lines.zh: : 她的神不认可{i}你{/i}吗？你们不是最好的朋友吗？

lines.en: : I see her as more of a little sister at this point, but I believe your description is apt as well. Regardless, I see no good coming from acting out against the wishes of one of our classmates.
lines.zh: : 如今我更把她看成妹妹，不过你的形容也算贴切。无论如何，我不认为违抗一位同班同学的意愿会有什么好结果。

lines.en: : Just make out with Rin later. Doing that in church is a no-go anyway. Too many dead saints watching you. Sounds pretty gross if you ask me.
lines.zh: : 等会儿再和 Rin 亲热就是了。在教堂里干这事本来就不行。太多死掉的圣人在看着你。要我说还挺恶心的。

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch5
: I’m not worried about {i}making out{/i} with her right now. It just feels weird being out {i}here{/i} when all of them are in there.
lines.zh: : 我现在担心的不是跟她{i}亲热{/i}。只是她们都在里面，我一个人待在{i}外面{/i}感觉很怪。

lines.en: : Got it. {i}You’re{/i} worried there’s some crazy foursome going on and you ain’t about to lose your woman to our babe-magnet teacher.
lines.zh: : 明白了。{i}你{/i}是担心里面正在搞什么疯狂的四人行，你才不会把自己的女人输给我们那个万人迷老师。

lines.en: : And that’s another thing. Why is everyone in our class so...head over heels for him? Doesn’t anyone have any issues with...you know, the whole age gap thing?
lines.zh: : 还有一件事。为什么我们班所有人都这么……为他神魂颠倒？就没有人在意……你知道的，那个年龄差的问题吗？

lines.en: : I see no issue with that. I believe the bulk of us are more than capable of making such decisions for ourselves.
lines.zh: : 我看这没什么问题。我相信我们大多数人都有足够的能力为自己做出这样的决定。

lines.en: : Are you telling me {i}you’re{/i} trying to get with him too, Touka?
lines.zh: : 你是说{i}你{/i}也想跟他好上吗，Touka？

lines.en: : Define “get with.” This is a term I don’t believe I’ve heard before.
lines.zh: : 请定义一下「好上」。这个词我好像没听过。

lines.en: : She means “Are you trying to bang him?”
lines.zh: : 她的意思是「你想不想和他上床？」

lines.en: : Bang as in sexual intercourse, correct?
lines.zh: : Bang 是指性交，对吧？

lines.en: : Correct.
: I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Then apologies, Otoha- but I don't think you and I are close enough to be discussing such things.
lines.zh: : 那么抱歉，Otoha——但我觉得你我还没熟到可以讨论这种事的地步。

lines.en: : Imani? How about you?
lines.zh: : Imani？你呢？

lines.en: : Excuse me, Otoha, but I am an adult and I am allowed to sleep with whatever attractive, consenting senpai I {i}want{/i} to sleep with.
lines.zh: : 不好意思，Otoha，但我是成年人，我{i}想{/i}和哪个又帅又你情我愿的前辈上床，就和他上床。

lines.en: : Besides, it’s not like Sensei’s {i}actually{/i} going around sleeping with the class. Not gonna fault the guy for not dodging a bunch of cute, hormonal teens who want to jump his bones.
lines.zh: : 再说，老师又不是{i}真的{/i}满世界跟班上的女生睡觉。一堆荷尔蒙上脑、想扑上去的可爱少女往他身上贴，他也没躲，这我可不会怪他。

lines.en: : He’s our {i}teacher.{/i} That’s exactly what he should be doing. And you don’t know for sure that-
lines.zh: : 他是我们的{i}老师{/i}。他本来就该躲。而且你又不能确定——

lines.en: : The more you deny it, the more I think {i}you{/i} just wanna bone him too.
lines.zh: : 你越否认，我就越觉得{i}你{/i}其实也想跟他睡。

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch6
: Ugh...This is pointless. Just forget I said anything.
lines.zh: : 唉……没意义。就当我什么都没说。

lines.en: : Oh my. I think you may actually be onto something, Miss Imai.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。我觉得你可能真说中了什么，Imai 小姐。

lines.en: : Otoha, in all seriousness, if you {i}know{/i} something, you can talk to me. But only if you {i}know{/i} something.
lines.zh: : Otoha，说真的，如果你{i}知道{/i}什么，可以跟我说。但前提是你真的{i}知道{/i}什么。

lines.en: : Because if you don’t, I’m not going to just let you stand there and slander my friend when all he’s done wrong is be mad creepy. That alone describes like, 98%% of guys.
lines.zh: : 因为如果你什么都不知道，我可不会让你站在这儿诋毁我的朋友——他唯一的错就是让人毛骨悚然得要命。光这一条就描述了大概 98%% 的男人。

lines.en: : Guess I’m glad I dated a girl first, then.
lines.zh: : 那我还挺庆幸自己先交了个女朋友。

lines.en: : Do you know something or not? Speak up.
lines.zh: : 你到底知道还是不知道？说话。

lines.en: scene black
: I barely even know him in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我本来就不太了解他。

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch7
: Ay! Welcome back, guys! How did- woah. Why does everybody look so sad and exhausted?
lines.zh: : 哎！你们回来了！怎么样——哇。为什么大家看起来都这么难过又疲惫？

lines.en: : Uhh...things...took a bit of a strange turn...
lines.zh: : 呃……事情……走向有点奇怪……

lines.en: : What kind of turn exactly?...
lines.zh: : 究竟是什么样的走向？……

lines.en: : Well...first...Sensei, uhh...
lines.zh: : 嗯……首先……老师，呃……

lines.en: : Let’s just say he had some trouble...umm...properly providing answers to...some of the questions...
lines.zh: : 这么说吧，他在……嗯……妥善回答某些问题时……遇到了一些麻烦……

lines.en: : But once that was over...we-
lines.zh: : 但那之后……我们就——

lines.en: : I lost.
lines.zh: : 我输了。

lines.en: : Yasu destroyed me and she barely even knows Sensei.
lines.zh: : Yasu 把我打得落花流水，而她几乎根本不了解老师。

lines.en: : It is not me who knows him, but-
lines.zh: : 了解他的人并不是我，而是——

lines.en: : Don’t try and make me feel better, Yasu. You won and you should get to be happy about that.
lines.zh: : 别试着让我好受，Yasu。你赢了，你就该为此高兴。

lines.en: : But here I am, once again rushing face first into things I think I can handle only to find out that everything is a lot bigger and harder than I think it is and no I am not talking about a penis.
lines.zh: : 可我又一次一头扎进自以为能应付的事情里，结果才发现一切都比我想的更大、更难——不，我说的不是鸡巴。

lines.en: : It’s...It’s not like you didn’t get {i}any{/i} right! You did really well...Yasu just...did better at the...hard questions...
lines.zh: : 你……你又不是{i}一题{/i}都没答对！你表现得很好……只是 Yasu 在……难题上……做得更好……

lines.en: : Just doing “well” isn’t good enough.
lines.zh: : 光是「很好」还不够。

lines.en: : A while ago, there wasn’t a single day that would go by without me thinking of Sensei.
lines.zh: : 曾几何时，我没有一天不想起老师。

lines.en: : Whether it be some customer reminding me of him or something I saw on TV that I thought he’d be interested in or...any of the secrets I wanted to tell him. Or any of the jokes I thought he’d scoff at.
lines.zh: : 不管是某个让我想起他的客人，还是电视上看到、觉得他会感兴趣的东西，又或者是……那些我想告诉他的秘密。或是我觉得他会嗤之以鼻的笑话。

lines.en: : What use do I even have anymore if I can’t even be bothered to remember anything about him?
lines.zh: : 如果我连关于他的事都懒得记住，我还有什么用？

lines.en: : You can not remember what you never learned in the first place...
lines.zh: : 你本来就从未知晓的事，是记不起来的……

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch8
: Didn’t stop {i}you...{/i}
lines.zh: : 可{i}你{/i}还是记住了……

lines.en: : Sensei...can you please...say something to Rin?...
lines.zh: : 老师……你能不能……对 Rin 说点什么？……

lines.en: : She seems...really upset about all this...
lines.zh: : 她看起来……真的很难过……

lines.en: : It’s fine, Sana.
lines.zh: : 没关系，Sana。

lines.en: : It’s my fault for letting him down in the first place.
lines.zh: : 本来就是我先让他失望的错。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
: And yet...giving him a small taste of his own medicine doesn’t feel good at all...
lines.zh: : 可即便如此……让他也尝尝这种滋味，一点也不好受……

lines.en: : I guess we really just aren’t that close anymore...
lines.zh: : 看来我们真的已经没那么亲近了……

lines.en: else:
: I’d be upset with me too...
lines.zh: : 换作我也会对自己失望的……

lines.en: scene black
I walk to the left.
lines.zh: 我向左走去。

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch9
: Uhh...
: You good, dude?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，兄弟？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : Uhh...
scene outsidethechurch10
: Well, on the bright side, at least I don’t have to be alone anymore! And that’s cool, right?
lines.zh: : 嗯，往好处想，至少我不用再一个人待着了！这很不错吧？

lines.en: : There’s no use staying upset about something that’s already in the past. So just...don’t let it get to you, alright?
lines.zh: : 为已经过去的事一直难过也没用。所以就……别往心里去，好吗？

lines.en: : It’s not exactly that easy.
lines.zh: : 没那么容易。

lines.en: : Sure it is. We’ve got plenty of stuff left that we can do before the night’s over and...I’m in a good mood today, so yeah!
lines.zh: : 当然容易。今晚结束前我们还有一堆事可以做，而且……我今天心情很好，所以就这样吧！

lines.en: : I’m just not really in the mood right now, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 我只是现在没什么心情，Otoha。

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch11
: Rin, seriously? It’s just a stupid contest. It’s not like it’s the end of your life or anything. Just move on so we can have fun.
lines.zh: : Rin，不是吧？那只是个愚蠢的比赛。又不是世界末日什么的。往前看，我们好去玩。

lines.en: : Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 哦豁。

lines.en: : Stupid?
lines.zh: : 愚蠢？

lines.en: : Yeah. It was stupid. You were having a contest to see who pays more attention to our thirty-some-odd year old teacher. You should be happy you lost. It means you’re not a creep.
lines.zh: : 对，就是愚蠢。你们在比赛谁更关注我们那个三十多岁的老师。输了你应该高兴才对，说明你不是个变态。

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch12
: There’s nothing creepy about caring about someone, Otoha! Someone I barely get to see anymore because the only one I pay attention to is you!
lines.zh: : 在乎一个人哪里变态了，Otoha！而我几乎见不到他了，只因为我唯一在意的人是你！

lines.en: : And...And that’s somehow {i}my{/i} problem?
lines.zh: : 而且……而且这怎么就成了{i}我的{/i}问题？

lines.en: : No! It’s mine! But it doesn’t help when you just throw it in my face like that and call me names for getting upset about a thing that’s very important to me!
lines.zh: : 不！是我的问题！可你这样当着我的面甩出来，还因为我为对我很重要的东西难过而骂我，一点用都没有！

lines.en: : Yo, chill. I didn’t mean it like-
lines.zh: : 喂，冷静点。我不是那个意思——

lines.en: : Then how did you mean it?! Tell me!
lines.zh: : 那你是什么意思？！说啊！

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch13
: Was this fate inevitable?
lines.zh: : 这是注定的命运吗？

lines.en: : Or is the world among the lines where these ones do not form a knot?
lines.zh: : 还是说，这个世界处在那些不会打成结的线条之间？

lines.en: : Umm...I don’t know for sure, but...I think they were...acting a little weird yesterday, too...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我不太确定，不过……我觉得她们……昨天也有点怪怪的……

lines.en: : I don’t...think it’s your fault, Yasu...I think it’s just...hard to...be in a relationship sometimes...
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得是你的错，Yasu……我觉得只是……有时候谈恋爱……本来就很难……

lines.en: : The saddest part is...the real difficulties have yet to even arise...
lines.zh: : 最悲哀的是……真正的困难甚至还没出现……

lines.en: : All that appears before us now is an aftereffect of the knowledge I was trusted with...being re-dispersed into the air and then your lungs...
lines.zh: : 此刻呈现在我们面前的，只是我所被托付的知识重新散入空气、再被你们吸进肺里之后的余波……

lines.en: : But I wanted it to make you happy.
lines.zh: : 可我本想让它让你们开心。

lines.en: : I wanted to disbelieve those whispers in the wind.
lines.zh: : 我本想不去相信风中那些低语。

lines.en: : Instead, I have let them grow so loud that we must now face a storm...
lines.zh: : 结果我却任由它们变得如此响亮，以至于我们现在必须面对一场风暴……

lines.en: : I...don’t understand what any of that means...
lines.zh: : 我……听不懂你说的这些……

lines.en: : It means that I am sorry...
lines.zh: : 意思是我很抱歉……

lines.en: : And that even with these powers...and these ears...beneath the slimy facade that is my soft, pliable exoskeleton...
lines.zh: : 还有，即便拥有这些力量……这对耳朵……在我那柔软可塑的外骨骼之下那层黏腻的表象之下……

lines.en: : I am still only human.
lines.zh: : 我也终究只是个凡人。

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch14
: The fuck is your problem?! Literally all I wanted to do was hang out with you. Is that really so bad?
lines.zh: : 你他妈有什么毛病？！我真的只是想和你一起玩而已。这真的很过分吗？

lines.en: : No! What’s bad is you making me feel like shit all the time for thinking about anyone other than you!
lines.zh: : 不！过分的是你总是因为我想起你以外的人就让我觉得自己很糟糕！

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch15
: I’m surprised you even {i}have{/i} time to think about me when all you {i}really{/i} ever do is think about yourself!
lines.zh: : 我真惊讶你{i}居然还有{/i}时间想我——你{i}明明{/i}一天到晚只想着你自己！

lines.en: : I left my club for you! I left my friends for you!
lines.zh: : 我为你退了社团！我为你离开了朋友！

lines.en: : You have other friends!
lines.zh: : 你还有别的朋友！

lines.en: : What have you given up for me, huh?! Why am I the only person who should have to sacrifice the things I love to make this work?!
lines.zh: : 你又为我放弃了什么，啊？！为什么只有我一个人必须牺牲自己热爱的东西来维持这段关系？！

lines.en: : Do you love Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你爱老师吗？

lines.en: : Yes! I do! Is that a problem?!
lines.zh: : 爱！我爱他！这有什么问题吗？！

lines.en: : How do you love him, Rin?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么爱他的，Rin？

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch16
: What the fuck are you even talking about? He’s a precious friend.
lines.zh: : 你他妈到底在说什么？他是个珍贵的朋友。

lines.en: : {i}Was{/i} a precious friend. You’re the one who decided to leave him behind to date me. Remember?
lines.zh: : {i}曾经是{/i}珍贵的朋友。当初决定把他抛在身后、来和我交往的人是你。记得吗？

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch17
: But who’s the one who always tries to change the subject whenever I bring him up?
lines.zh: : 可每次我提起他，就急着转移话题的人是谁？

lines.en: : Why do you need to bring him up?
lines.zh: : 你为什么非得提起他？

lines.en: : Who’s the one who gets jealous any time I make eye contact with someone I’ve had a crush on before?
lines.zh: : 每次我和以前喜欢过的人对上眼就吃醋的人是谁？

lines.en: : Obviously me. But it’s not wrong for me to feel that way when you’re a walking mass of unrestrained hormones!
lines.zh: : 显然是我。可你本身就是一团到处乱走的荷尔蒙，我这么想也没错吧！

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch18
: Do you think I’m going to just forget I’m dating you and spend those hormones on somebody else?!
lines.zh: : 你觉得我会忘了自己正在和你交往，然后把那些荷尔蒙用在别人身上？！

lines.en: : I don’t know what you’re going to do! That’s the problem!
lines.zh: : 我不知道你会做什么！这才是问题所在！

lines.en: : Besides, I wouldn’t even {i}have{/i} all of those hormones if you’d stop being A FUCKING PRUDE and just finger me already!
lines.zh: : 再说，你要不是个该死的古板鬼、早点用手指帮我，我根本不会{i}有{/i}这么多荷尔蒙！

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch19
: Okay, {i}that{/i} had to have snapped you out of it, right?
lines.zh: : 好了，{i}这下{/i}总该把你震醒了吧？

lines.en: : Snapped me out of what? What happened?
lines.zh: : 震醒什么？发生什么了？

lines.en: : W...What the fuck do you think you’re yelling about?!
lines.zh: : 你……你他妈到底在吼什么？！

lines.en: : I’m angry! And sad! And I feel like shit for fucking up the one thing I thought I’d never fuck up! And it doesn’t help to have you come over and be like “Hey, Rin! I’m your girlfriend! Time to move on!”
lines.zh: : 我生气！我难过！我把自以为永远不会搞砸的唯一一件事搞砸了，这感觉糟透了！而你跑过来说「嘿，Rin！我是你女朋友！该往前看了！」一点忙都帮不上！

lines.en: : That’s not what I was trying to do!
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思！

lines.en: : Then try harder!
lines.zh: : 那就再努力点！

lines.en: : You should {i}know{/i} how important Sensei is to me! So when you tell me that I’m getting upset over a “stupid contest,” yeah! I’m going to be mad!
lines.zh: : 你明明该{i}知道{/i}老师对我有多重要！所以当你说我是在为一场「愚蠢的比赛」难过时，没错！我就是会生气！

lines.en: : It’s not like I lost to Ami or Ayane! I lost to {i}Yasu!{/i} YASU!
lines.zh: : 我又不是输给 Ami 或 Ayane！我输给了 {i}Yasu{/i}！YASU！

lines.en: : I’m losing the only connection I’ve {i}ever{/i} had with a male authority figure and you want me to just {i}move on{/i} and {i}hang out{/i} with you like nothing horrible is happening in the background?!
lines.zh: : 我正在失去我唯一一位男性长辈的羁绊，而你却要我若无其事地{i}往前看{/i}、和你{i}一起玩{/i}，就好像背后什么可怕的事都没在发生？！

lines.en: : Things aren’t that easy for everyone!
lines.zh: : 不是每个人都能那么轻松！

lines.en: : What I {i}want{/i} is for you to stop getting so upset about relationships like that because it makes me feel like you’re falling for {i}them{/i} instead of me!
lines.zh: : 我{i}想要{/i}的是你别再为那种关系那么难过，因为这会让我觉得你爱上的是{i}他们{/i}，而不是我！

lines.en: : Well, to paraphrase the magnificent and super-cool, {i}TOTALLY{/i} not prudish Otoha Okakura...that’s your problem! Not mine!
lines.zh: : 好吧，借用伟大又超酷、{i}绝对{/i}不古板的 Otoha Okakura 的话来说……那是你的问题！不是我的！

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch20
: Oh, fuck this! I’m going home!
lines.zh: : 哦，去他的！我回家了！

lines.en: : Cool! Bye! Hope my “unrestrained hormones” don’t explode all over Kumon-mi and spread a bajillion pheromones across the city that signal to everyone how it’s okay to come put things in my vagina!
lines.zh: : 好啊！再见！但愿我那些「不受约束的荷尔蒙」不会在 Kumon-mi 炸开，向全城散布一万亿信息素，昭告所有人都可以来把东西塞进我的阴道！

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch21
: What the fuck are you even yelling now?! What does that mean?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈现在又在吼什么？！那是什么意思？！

lines.en: : I don’t know! Just leave me alone!
lines.zh: : 我不知道！别管我！

lines.en: scene black
Otoha walks off into the dark, but none of us follow her.
lines.zh: Otoha 走进了黑暗里，但我们没有一个人跟上去。

lines.en: We probably should have.
lines.zh: 我们大概本该跟上去的。

lines.en: This is not somewhere a young girl should be alone at night.
lines.zh: 这可不是年轻女孩夜里该独自待的地方。

lines.en: But we all want to leave as well.
lines.zh: 可我们也都想离开。

lines.en: And the bus stop is in the opposite direction.
lines.zh: 而公交站在相反的方向。

lines.en: When I sit down on the bus, I feel something poking out of my back pocket.
lines.zh: 当我在巴士上坐下时，感觉到有什么东西从后口袋里戳了出来。

lines.en: I reach for it, paying close attention to my surroundings to make sure no one is watching.
lines.zh: 我伸手去摸，同时密切留意四周，确认没人看着。

lines.en: But when I inspect it, I find that it’s just a picture of a flower.
lines.zh: 可当我拿出来一看，发现那只是一张花的照片。

lines.en: I hope the ride back is a quick one.
lines.zh: 但愿回程能快一点。

lines.en: {i}Meanwhile, in a functional lesbian relationship...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时，在一段健康运作的蕾丝关系里……{/i}

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch22
: God...I have no idea how you have the patience to do this every single day. I feel like I’ve poked myself in the eye a good seven hundred times by now.
lines.zh: : 天哪……我真不知道你怎么能有耐心每天都弄这个。我觉得自己到现在已经戳到眼睛大概七百次了。

lines.en: : And you’ll poke yourself seven hundred more if it means I get my yearly dose of Gothsako. There are simply some sacrifices that must be made in the name of love, my darling.
lines.zh: : 只要能让我一年一度见到哥特版 Osako，你还会再戳七百次。以爱之名，总有些牺牲是必须做出的，亲爱的。

lines.en: : I wish you had more fantasies about me in jeans and no makeup.
lines.zh: : 我真希望你多幻想一下我穿牛仔裤、素颜的样子。

lines.en: : I have fantasies about you in all forms of attire. But that does not mean I’m going to make you indulge me by forcing you to dress as my third grade teacher, Ms. Takeda.
lines.zh: : 你穿什么样的衣服我都幻想过。但这不代表我要你迁就我，逼你打扮成我三年级的老师 Takeda 小姐。

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch23
: Wakana, I love you, but we’ve been together for years now and I’m tired of hearing about Ms. Takeda.
lines.zh: : Wakana，我爱你，可我们都在一起这么多年了，我听够了 Takeda 小姐的事。

lines.en: : Then talk about your first crush to even the playing field. Who was it again? Some sort of...actor? Musician?
lines.zh: : 那你也说说你的初恋对象，好扯平。是谁来着？某个……演员？音乐人？

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch24
: Britney Spears.
lines.zh: : Britney Spears。

lines.en: : Right, right. I forgot there was a time in your life where you weren’t fully dedicated to being swallowed by the darkness that is Wakana Watabe.
lines.zh: : 对，对。我都忘了你人生中也曾有过一段还没全心全意被 Wakana Watabe 这片黑暗吞噬的时光。

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch25
: Or at least being {i}licked{/i} by her.
lines.zh: : 或者至少是被她{i}舔{/i}过。

lines.en: : Not again. You’ve {i}licked{/i} me to completion five times today and are the reason I am currently reapplying my makeup in the first place. Please contain yourself. We have plans.
lines.zh: : 别又来。你今天已经把我{i}舔{/i}到高潮五次了，我现在要重新化妆也全是因为你。请克制一下。我们还有安排。

lines.en: : But I can only have sex with Gothsako one day out of every year. I need to make it count.
lines.zh: : 可我一年只有一天能和哥特版 Osako 上床。我得让它值回票价。

lines.en: : I already told you I’d be more than willing to do this on a weekly basis. {i}Just not right before we go out.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我说过了，每周来一次我都很乐意。{i}只是别在我们出门前。{/i}

lines.en: : My darling, doing this on a weekly basis would cause it to lose its charm. I like having something to look forward to for the holidays.
lines.zh: : 亲爱的，每周都来就会失去魅力。我喜欢为节日留点值得期待的东西。

lines.en: : Which is why I’m particularly excited for my upcoming {i}excursions{/i} with your Christmas elf variant. Remind me to cover our apartment in mistletoe, please.
lines.zh: : 所以我特别期待接下来和你圣诞精灵版本的{i}出游{/i}。记得提醒我把公寓挂满槲寄生。

lines.en: : You don’t need me to remind you. What I have learned over the years is that there are only four shades of Wakana — sleep, sex, work, and interior design.
lines.zh: : 你不需要我提醒。这些年我学到的是，Wakana 只有四种状态——睡觉、性爱、工作、室内设计。

lines.en: : The second I turn a blind eye to you, there will be mistletoe literally everywhere.
lines.zh: : 我只要一不留神，槲寄生就真的会挂得到处都是。

lines.en: : You should be happy you’ve found yourself such a predictable woman. Many people love that sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 你该高兴才对，找到了这么一个可预测的女人。很多人都喜欢这一型。

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch26
: I’d be happier if you’d actually help me with this instead of watching me struggle while fixing your hair.
lines.zh: : 你要是真来帮我、而不是一边弄头发一边看我手忙脚乱，我会更高兴。

lines.en: : Apologies, my sweet. But seeing as we have plans tonight, I can not allow my hair to be anything other than perfect.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我的甜心。不过既然我们今晚有安排，我就不能让头发有半点不完美。

lines.en: : Why? Trying to impress someone?
lines.zh: : 为什么？想给谁留下好印象？

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch27
: I did take the liberty of inviting Ms. Takeda, after all.
lines.zh: : 毕竟，我已经擅自邀请了 Takeda 小姐。

lines.en: : You drive me insane.
lines.zh: : 你快把我逼疯了。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, my kitten. I’m willing to share her.
lines.zh: : 别担心，我的小猫咪。我愿意把她分你一份。

lines.en: : Oh, are you now?
lines.zh: : 哦，是吗？

lines.en: : I can’t see why not. If anything, I welcome the challenge.
lines.zh: : 我看不出有什么不行。倒不如说，我很欢迎这个挑战。

lines.en: : My skills with one woman are quite exemplary, as I’m sure you’ve noticed. I wonder if they’d hold up with a second?
lines.zh: : 我应付一个女人的技术堪称典范，这点你肯定注意到了。不知道再来一个还撑不撑得住？

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch28
: Is that something you’re actually interested in?
lines.zh: : 你真的对这种事有兴趣？

lines.en: : Osako?
lines.zh: : Osako？

lines.en: : Threesomes, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我是说，三人行。

lines.en: : We’ve never really had that discussion before.
lines.zh: : 我们以前从没认真聊过这个。

lines.en: : My dear...you {i}are{/i} aware that I was just kidding, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 亲爱的……你{i}知道{/i}我刚才只是在开玩笑吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, but like...
lines.zh: : 嗯，不过……

lines.en: : I mean, I’d {i}get it{/i} if that’s something you wanted to do. And if that will help with-
lines.zh: : 我是说，如果那是你想做的事，我{i}能理解{/i}。而且如果这样能解决——

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch29
: Hah...this again?
lines.zh: : 哈……又来了？

lines.en: : I just want you to be happy, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你幸福，Wakana。

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch30
: I {i}am{/i} happy, love. And I mean that from the bottom of my heart.
lines.zh: : 我{i}很幸福{/i}，亲爱的。我是打心眼里这么说的。

lines.en: : There’s a “but” coming.
lines.zh: : 接下来要有个「不过」了。

lines.en: : Knew it.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。

lines.en: : Do you know what would make me even {i}happier?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你知道还有什么能让我{i}更幸福{/i}吗？

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch31
: Hah...
: Bed or couch?
lines.zh: : 床上还是沙发？

lines.en: : Both?
lines.zh: : 两个都要？

lines.en: : We only have time for one.
lines.zh: : 我们只来得及做一个。

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那就……

lines.en: : Kitchen.
lines.zh: : 厨房。

lines.en: : Fine.
: But if you’re going to handcuff me to something, it can’t be the cabinet with our pots and pans in it. The handle is still loose from last time.
lines.zh: : 但你要把我铐在什么上面，别铐那个放锅碗瓢盆的柜子。柜门把手上次弄松了还没修。

lines.en: : It’s okay to break things. We’re adults.
lines.zh: : 弄坏东西也没关系。我们都是成年人了。

lines.en: : You know...sometimes, it really feels like all of the physical and stamina training I’ve endured my entire life was all to prepare me for {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……有时候我真觉得，我这一生所受的所有体能与耐力训练，全都是为了迎接{i}你{/i}而做的准备。

lines.en: : And...would you change that if you could?
lines.zh: : 那么……如果能重来，你会改变吗？

lines.en: scene outsidethechurch32
: Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 绝对不会。

lines.en: : Let’s go break some cabinets.
lines.zh: : 走吧，去砸几个柜子。
